The 'untitled Talking Tom movie' is an upcoming animated hybrid family film based on the franchise. The movie will be produced by Outfit7, Marla Studios and Mythology Entertainment. First announced in 2014, the film has since been in production since 2018. The movie currently does not have a release date.
Premise
The premise of the film will be about animated characters from the franchise into a live action scenery.
Production
The movie was first announced in October 2014 by former CEO Samo Login. The announcement came after a series of games hit 2 billion downloads total. The film was confirmed to be directed by Valerie Weiss and produced by Mythology Entertainment and the co-founder James Vanderbilt, Brad Fischer and William Sharek and Login as executive producer.
In 2018, it was announced the production had started. It was also confirmed that the film would include a mix of a live-action landscape and animated characters from the Talking Tom & Friends franchise, and that it would produced alongside by Marla Studios. In 2019, the film was confirmed to be in its scripting stage. Outfit7 then confirmed that Jean-Julien Baronnet, producer of Rabbids Invasion, was hired and would also produce the film. In 2024, Senior Vice President of Outfit7 Jernej Česen stated that the movie will take some time for meeting standards.
